title: Claims Payments Service Standards for Cardinal Rental Reimbursement
content:
These standards set the time limits for receipts and payments under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement, and the amount at which an agency invoice is reviewed. The figures are the same on all six options: 30/900, 40/1200, 50/1500, 60/1800, 75/2250 and 100/3000.

| Standard | Every option |
|---|---|
| Calendar days after the rental ends within which receipts for reimbursement must be submitted | 60 |
| Reimbursement needs itemized receipts | Yes |
| Calendar days after complete receipts are received within which reimbursement is paid | 10 |
| Calendar days after a direct-bill invoice is received within which it is paid | 30 |
| Amount by which an invoice may exceed the authorized days times the daily limit before it is reviewed ahead of payment | $25.00 |

## What each standard measures

- **Receipt submission window (60 calendar days).** This window runs from the end of the rental. It limits the time the customer has to submit receipts for reimbursement.
- **Itemized receipts.** Reimbursement is made against itemized receipts.
- **Reimbursement payment (10 calendar days).** This period runs from the day complete receipts are received.
- **Agency invoice payment (30 calendar days).** This period runs from the day a partner agency's direct-bill invoice is received.
- **Invoice review amount ($25.00).** This is the invoice amount, in US dollars, above the authorized days times the daily limit at which an invoice is reviewed before payment.

## Example (hypothetical dates)

Complete receipts are received on August 4. The 10-day reimbursement standard is met by a payment made on or before August 14.

An agency invoice is received on August 4. The 30-day standard is met by a payment made on or before September 3.
